understanding.confirmed: 206 means response headers were returned; it does not guarantee full ranged PDF body was successfully consumed.
understanding.supported: 8.99/9.01/12.00s closely coincide with configured 9s warmup and 12s first Range timeout and indicate attempts timing out on received/streamed data.
understanding.likely: Broken/slow China campus-to-Cloudflare route and possible Ghelper per-domain split; extension-off direct path also unavailable, so cannot ascribe all failures to Ghelper alone.
understanding.notProven: Ghelper node exclusively at fault, which URL was actually proxied, each Content-Range length and completed response body bytes, actual fallback ticket attempts, any permission defect
understanding.majorConstraint: Both API_BASE and API_BACKUP use Cloudflare; Tencent PR#420 still draft and routing.enabled=false, so existing 'backup' does not provide a China-independent ingress.
